verses.text: So long as we live in the world, we cannot be without trouble and trial.
verses.modernizedText: As long as we live in the world, we cannot be without trouble and trial.

verses.text: Wherefore it is written in Job, The life of man upon the earth is a trial.(1) And therefore ought each of us to give heed concerning trials and temptations, and watch unto prayer, lest the devil find occasion to deceive; for he never sleepeth, but goeth about seeking whom he may devour.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore it is written in Job, The life of man upon the earth is a trial.(1) And so each of us ought to pay attention to trials and temptations and watch in prayer, lest the devil find an opportunity to deceive; for he never sleeps, but goes about seeking whom he may devour.

verses.text: No man is so perfect in holiness that he hath never temptations, nor can we ever be wholly free from them.
verses.modernizedText: No one is so perfect in holiness that he never has temptations, nor can we ever be wholly free from them.

verses.text: Yet, notwithstanding, temptations turn greatly unto our profit, even though they be great and hard to bear; for through them we are humbled, purified, instructed.
verses.modernizedText: Yet temptations benefit us greatly, even though they are great and hard to bear, for through them we are humbled, purified, and instructed.

verses.text: All Saints have passed through much tribulation and temptation, and have profited thereby.
verses.modernizedText: All Saints have passed through much tribulation and temptation and have benefited from it.

verses.text: And they who endured not temptation became reprobate and fell away.
verses.modernizedText: And those who did not endure temptation became reprobate and fell away.

verses.text: There is no position so sacred, no place so secret, that it is without temptations and adversities.
verses.modernizedText: There is no position so sacred, no place so secret, that it is without temptations and adversities.

verses.text: There is no man wholly free from temptations so long as he liveth, because we have the root of temptation within ourselves, in that we are born in concupiscence.
verses.modernizedText: No one is wholly free from temptations as long as he lives, because we have the root of temptation within ourselves, since we are born in concupiscence.

verses.text: One temptation or sorrow passeth, and another cometh; and always we shall have somewhat to suffer, for we have fallen from perfect happiness.
verses.modernizedText: One temptation or sorrow passes, and another comes; and we will always have something to suffer, for we have fallen from perfect happiness.

verses.text: Many who seek to fly from temptations fall yet more deeply into them.
verses.modernizedText: Many who seek to flee from temptations fall even more deeply into them.

verses.text: By flight alone we cannot overcome, but by endurance and true humility we are made stronger than all our enemies.
verses.modernizedText: By flight alone we cannot overcome, but through endurance and true humility we are made stronger than all our enemies.

verses.text: He who only resisteth outwardly and pulleth not up by the root, shall profit little; nay, rather temptations will return to him the more quickly, and will be the more terrible.
verses.modernizedText: The person who resists only outwardly and does not pull temptation up by the root will profit little; indeed, temptations will return to him more quickly and will be more terrible.

verses.text: Little by little, through patience and long-suffering, thou shalt conquer by the help of God, rather than by violence and thine own strength of will.
verses.modernizedText: Little by little, through patience and long-suffering, you will conquer with the help of God, rather than by violence and your own strength of will.

verses.text: In the midst of temptation often seek counsel; and deal not hardly with one who is tempted, but comfort and strengthen him as thou wouldest have done unto thyself.
verses.modernizedText: In the midst of temptation, often seek counsel; and do not deal harshly with someone who is tempted, but comfort and strengthen him as you would wish to be treated yourself.

verses.text: The beginning of all temptations to evil is instability of temper and want of trust in God; for even as a ship without a helm is tossed about by the waves, so is a man who is careless and infirm of purpose tempted, now on this side, now on that.
verses.modernizedText: The beginning of all temptations to evil is instability of temper and lack of trust in God; for just as a ship without a helm is tossed about by the waves, so a person who is careless and weak in purpose is tempted now on this side, now on that.

verses.text: As fire testeth iron, so doth temptation the upright man.
verses.modernizedText: As fire tests iron, so temptation tests the upright person.

verses.text: Oftentimes we know not what strength we have; but temptation revealeth to us what we are.
verses.modernizedText: Often we do not know what strength we have, but temptation reveals to us what we are.

verses.text: Nevertheless, we must watch, especially in the beginnings of temptation; for then is the foe the more easily mastered, when he is not suffered to enter within the mind, but is met outside the door as soon as he hath knocked.
verses.modernizedText: Nevertheless, we must watch, especially at the beginnings of temptation; for the enemy is more easily mastered when he is not allowed to enter the mind, but is met outside the door as soon as he has knocked.

verses.text: Wherefore one saith,
verses.modernizedText: Therefore someone says,

verses.text: Check the beginnings; once thou might’st have cured, But now ’tis past thy skill, too long hath it endured.
verses.modernizedText: Check the beginnings; once you might have cured, But now it is beyond your skill, it has endured too long.

verses.text: For first cometh to the mind the simple suggestion, then the strong imagination, afterwards pleasure, evil affection, assent.
verses.modernizedText: For first the simple suggestion comes to the mind, then the strong imagination, afterward pleasure, evil affection, and assent.

verses.text: And so little by little the enemy entereth in altogether, because he was not resisted at the beginning.
verses.modernizedText: And so little by little the enemy enters altogether, because he was not resisted at the beginning.

verses.text: And the longer a man delayeth his resistance, the weaker he groweth, and the stronger groweth the enemy against him.
verses.modernizedText: And the longer a person delays his resistance, the weaker he grows and the stronger the enemy grows against him.

verses.text: Some men suffer their most grievous temptations in the beginning of their conversion, some at the end.
verses.modernizedText: Some suffer their most grievous temptations at the beginning of their conversion, some at the end.

verses.text: Some are sorely tried their whole life long.
verses.modernizedText: Some are severely tried their whole life long.

verses.text: Some there are who are tempted but lightly, according to the wisdom and justice of the ordering of God, who knoweth the character and circumstances of men, and ordereth all things for the welfare of His elect.
verses.modernizedText: Some are tempted only lightly, according to the wisdom and justice of God’s ordering, who knows the character and circumstances of people and orders all things for the welfare of His elect.

verses.text: Therefore we ought not to despair when we are tempted, but the more fervently should cry unto God, that He will vouchsafe to help us in all our tribulation; and that He will, as St. Paul saith, with the temptation make a way to escape that we may be able to bear it.(2) Let us therefore humble ourselves under the mighty hand of God in all temptation and trouble, for He will save and exalt such as are of an humble spirit.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore, we ought not to despair when we are tempted, but should cry more fervently to God that He will graciously help us in all our tribulation; and that He will, as St. Paul says, with the temptation make a way to escape that we may be able to bear it.(2) Let us therefore humble ourselves under the mighty hand of God in all temptation and trouble, for He will save and exalt those who are humble in spirit.

verses.text: In temptations and troubles a man is proved, what progress he hath made, and therein is his reward the greater, and his virtue doth the more appear.
verses.modernizedText: In temptations and troubles a person is tested as to what progress he has made; in them his reward is greater, and his virtue appears all the more.

verses.text: Nor is it a great thing if a man be devout and zealous so long as he suffereth no affliction; but if he behave himself patiently in the time of adversity, then is there hope of great progress.
verses.modernizedText: Nor is it a great thing if a person is devout and zealous as long as he suffers no affliction; but if he behaves patiently in the time of adversity, then there is hope of great progress.

verses.text: Some are kept safe from great temptations, but are overtaken in those which are little and common, that the humiliation may teach them not to trust to themselves in great things, being weak in small things.
verses.modernizedText: Some are kept safe from great temptations but are overtaken by those that are little and common, so that the humiliation may teach them not to trust themselves in great things when they are weak in small things.
